component: In-app notification interaction retention assertion scope

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The moved update test filters interactedWith using ({ id }), while markAsInteractedWith stores scalar string IDs. That filter sees undefined for each normal string ID and can return [] without testing the intended stored-ID relation. Fixed test_builtinIdsStay explicitly preserves bundled IDs across an empty feed update; the update implementation intersects stored IDs with the union of feed and bundled IDs. A proposed assertion correction must compare scalar IDs and distinguish retained bundled IDs from removed mock IDs. This is a static assertion gap, not an observed intermittent cause, applied fix or instruction to clear all interaction state. Any future assertion message should state the intended retained or removed ID behavior. No source or test edit is made in this study.
title: The notification update test destructures stored scalar interaction IDs
